krakow.tytul: Here, a listing won’t tell you everything.
krakow.lede: The Kraków market has its own pitfalls. Besides the land register and the owners’ association’s documents, we check things that in this region can change a property’s value or a buyer’s plans.

karty.tekst: Entry in the register or the municipal list of historic buildings, conservation zones and the rules of the Old Town Cultural Park. They decide which works need the conservator’s consent and what may be changed on the facade.
We check the flood hazard maps for the Vistula and its tributaries: the Wilga, Prądnik, Dłubnia and Serafa. This matters for safety and for the cost of insurance.
A restricted-use area applies around Kraków-Balice airport. We check whether the property lies within it and what that means for noise and building.
Around Wieliczka and Bochnia we check whether the property is within reach of the old salt mine workings.
A cooperative ownership right to a flat often has no land register entry. We establish the legal position with the cooperative and check whether it is worth opening a register before the sale.

karty.tytul: What may be built next door
karty.tekst: We check whether a local zoning plan covers the area and, if not, which planning decisions have been issued nearby.

proces.tytul: Five stages, from the first conversation to the notarial deed.
proces.lede: Nothing is signed at the first meeting. We leave the agreement with you to read at your own pace.

kroki.tekst: We come over, look at the property, ask about the documents and listen.
We check the legal and physical condition. If something is wrong, we tell you straight away, not three months later.
We compare actual transaction prices from notarial deeds for similar properties nearby, not asking prices from listings. This is not a valuation.
Photo shoot, video, a dimensioned floor plan and a description based only on verified facts. Publication on selected portals.
Viewings, negotiations, the preliminary agreement and the documents for the notary. A written report every week.

wiersze.wartosc: The layout was well received. Two people mentioned the lack of a lift.
Interest is steady. Questions are mostly about running costs.
Two viewings on Saturday, adding a breakdown of charges to the listing.

faq.tytul: Rules, regulations and answers to common questions.
faq.lede: We operate within Polish law on real estate management, personal data protection, consumer rights, and anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing.

odpowiedz: There is one published rate: [[stawka]]. On a sale, the fee is paid by the seller only, once the sale agreement has been signed as a notarial deed. We accept payment by bank transfer only. For difficult cases, the preparatory stage is priced separately. The Verification Report for buyers has a fixed price.

pytania.pytanie: Is the Verification Report legal advice or a legal opinion?
odpowiedz: No. The report is an analytical document: it sets out facts established from documents and the sources listed, compares and analyses them. It is not a legal opinion, advice of any kind or a valuation, and it contains no recommendation. Where legal help is needed, the right person is an advocate, a legal adviser or a notary.

Yes. A real estate broker in Poland must hold third-party liability insurance for damage caused in connection with brokerage activities. Each of us has our own policy. We give the policy numbers on this website, in the agreement and in every report: [[polisy]].

pytania.pytanie: Why do you need an identity document?
odpowiedz: A real estate broker is an obliged institution under the Polish Act on Counteracting Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing. Before starting work with a client, we must apply customer due diligence measures, including identifying the client and verifying their identity and, in certain cases, establishing the beneficial owner. If these measures cannot be applied, the law does not allow us to work together.

pytania.pytanie: What form does the brokerage agreement take?
odpowiedz: Under Polish law, a brokerage agreement must be made in writing or in electronic form, otherwise it is invalid. It sets out the scope of work, the fee and how the fee is calculated. We never sign the agreement at the first meeting.

pytania.pytanie: Can I withdraw from the agreement?
odpowiedz: Yes, if you are a consumer. We have no fixed office, so our agreements are concluded off-premises or at a distance. In that case you may withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason, under the Polish Consumer Rights Act. You will receive information about this right and a model withdrawal form together with the agreement.
If you would like us to start work before that period ends, we will ask you for an explicit request in writing.

pytania.pytanie: How is a price analysis different from a valuation?
odpowiedz: A price analysis compares the transaction prices of similar properties nearby, based on prices in notarial deeds rather than in listings. It is not a valuation. Formal valuations are carried out by licensed property valuers.

Before a property goes on the market, we verify it, arrange a photo shoot and prepare a campaign. Without exclusivity we cannot do this properly. The term of the agreement and how it can be terminated are set out in the agreement, which you receive to read before signing.
Kraków and the counties of Kraków, Wieliczka, Myślenice and Bochnia. The full list of municipalities is in the [Where we work](#obszar) section.

pytania.pytanie: Which language do you work in?
odpowiedz: Meetings and documents are in Polish. If you are more comfortable in another language, we will arrange an interpreter. At the notary, a sworn translator is required by law when a party does not speak Polish, and we organise this in advance.

pytania.pytanie: Can I sell or let a property while living abroad?
odpowiedz: Yes. We can handle a sale or letting remotely: we prepare the documents in advance and keep you informed through the weekly report. The notarial deed of sale can be signed on your behalf by an attorney-in-fact.

pytania.pytanie: How is my personal data processed?
odpowiedz: Only to the extent necessary and only for the purpose for which it was provided. Details, including your rights, are in the [information on the processing of personal data](okno:rodo).

rodo.tytul: Information on the processing of personal data

tresc.akapit: In accordance with Article 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council (GDPR), we inform you that:
Your data is controlled by the partners of the civil-law partnership [[nazwa_pelna]], [[adres]], NIP (tax ID) [[nip]]. Contact on personal data matters: [[email]], [[telefon]].

lista: Responding to your enquiry and contact before an agreement is concluded, at your request: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Concluding and performing a brokerage agreement or an agreement to prepare a Verification Report: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Compliance with legal obligations, in particular under the Act on Counteracting Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and tax and accounting law: Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
Establishing, pursuing or defending claims: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on our legitimate interest.

tresc.akapit: Data from enquiries that did not lead to an agreement is kept for no longer than [[okres_przechowywania_zapytan]]. Data related to an agreement is kept for the duration of the agreement and then until the limitation periods for claims and the periods required by tax law have expired. Documentation collected as part of customer due diligence is kept for 5 years from the first day of the year following the year in which the business relationship ended or the occasional transaction was carried out, as required by the Act on Counteracting Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing.

Data may be shared with entities that provide services to us under data processing agreements (hosting, e-mail, accounting, IT systems), and with entities authorised by law, including the General Inspector of Financial Information. When a transaction is carried out, we pass the necessary data to the notary. [[poza_eog]]

You have the right to access your data, to rectify, erase or restrict its processing, to data portability and to object to processing based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).

Providing data in the form is voluntary but necessary for us to reply. Providing the data required by anti-money laundering law is a condition of concluding an agreement. We do not make automated decisions and do not carry out profiling.

rodo.formularz_program: Data from the form goes directly to the software we use to run the agency’s cases and is kept there for the period stated above.
rodo.formularz_poczta: The form does not store any data on the website’s server. Once completed, it prepares an e-mail which you send yourself from your own e-mail program.
rodo.poza_eog: If any provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, this must be stated here together with the legal basis for the transfer.

tresc.akapit: As a real estate broker, we are an obliged institution under the Polish Act of 1 March 2018 on Counteracting Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing. This means obligations that apply to every client, regardless of the value of the transaction.

lista: We identify each client and verify their identity on the basis of an identity document.
For legal persons and other entities, we establish who is authorised to represent them and who the beneficial owner is.
We assess the business relationship and, where justified, establish the purpose and nature of the transaction and the source of funds.
We establish whether the client is a politically exposed person.
We monitor the business relationship on an ongoing basis.

tresc.akapit: If customer due diligence measures cannot be applied, the law does not allow us to start working together or to carry out the transaction. Nor may we inform clients that information has been passed to the General Inspector of Financial Information.

Copies of documents and information obtained as part of these measures are kept for the period required by the Act. Details on personal data are given in the [information on the processing of personal data](okno:rodo).
This website does not use cookies, analytics tools or advertising pixels.

The website stores only technical information in your browser: that the welcome animation has already been shown in this tab (until the tab is closed) and a copy of the page so that it can be opened without an internet connection. This information is not used to recognise or track visitors.

The website’s fonts and images are loaded from its own server. The list of properties and their photos are loaded from the server of our agency’s software. The “Area on the map” link opens OpenStreetMap only when you click it.
If we introduce analytics or advertising tools in the future, we will ask for your consent before using them and update this information.
